scope: Run-local 0.01 feature anisotropy filter zero-offset VIO/EGO/PX4 SITL repeat with read-only PX4 bridge yaw-alignment telemetry. No acceptance claim.

comparison.prior_outcome: Action succeeded and remained under accel-bias threshold, then PX4 frame-alignment protection and long_tracks_insufficient occurred; ULog confirmed eventual touchdown/disarm.
comparison.current_outcome: Same verified zero-offset target config; action aborted on accel_bias_norm_exceeded; no px4_frame_alignment_drift event was recorded.
comparison.interpretation: The #217 zero-offset bias abort invalidates the earlier small-sample association between horizontal targets and the accel-bias gate. Independent starts vary; neither horizontal motion nor the run-local filter is established as causal.

setup.bridge_diagnostic_change: alignment_yaw_error_rad, computed by the existing bridge alignment check and published in read-only detail JSON; it is not used for control or fault decisions.
setup.bridge_diagnostic_effect: Read-only field; not used for alignment thresholds, faults or control decisions.
setup.build: Run-local colcon build completed: 6 packages finished; source bridge diagnostic compiled.

bias_gate.metric_semantics: VINS telemetry reports the norm of the current estimator accel-bias state; this is an estimated state, not ground-truth sensor bias.
bias_gate.cost_gate_at_abort: The first invalid localization status had normalized_cost below the unchanged 1.0 limit; the action aborted on the accel-bias gate.
bias_gate.post_abort_qualification: Raw VINS cost samples and image-residual capture after localization locked are diagnostics only, not accepted localization or goal samples.

alignment_diagnostic.interpretation: The latest fresh ACTIVE pair before the bias abort remained below both configured alignment limits. Later LANDING detail became stale; it is not used to infer fault-time yaw. This run did not reproduce the #216 alignment fault.

visual_residuals.interpretation_limit: These residual rows span temporal/stereo factors from a post-abort sample. They do not identify which candidate features passed the run-local filter.

tests.build: colcon build --packages-select uav_interfaces uav_sim uav_localization uav_mapping uav_px4_bridge uav_navigation: passed (6 packages)

interpretation: This is a zero-offset run that crossed the existing estimated accel-bias gate and failed closed; it therefore shows that the gate event is not specific to horizontal target runs in this small sample. It does not establish the run-local feature filter as causal. PX4 landed and disarmed with EV aiding observed, GNSS aiding flags at zero, and a transient DESCEND/failsafe state. The direct yaw diagnostic stayed below the configured alignment gate in fresh ACTIVE pairs and no alignment fault reproduced. P5 remains in progress.
limitations: This diagnostic run is not P5 acceptance; the requested navigation goal did not succeed.
Estimated accel-bias state is not compared with ground-truth sensor bias.
Independent SITL starts are not a causal paired experiment.
Yaw at the exact bias abort is unavailable because bridge alignment samples became stale during LANDING.
The visual residual capture was post-abort and cannot establish candidate admission or filter effect.
No runtime truth pose or complete world map was supplied to navigation or evaluation.

cross_run_readonly_comparison.method: Read-only comparison of saved per-run VINS estimator telemetry and localization validity histories; first sample with accel_bias_norm >0.15 m/s^2 is selected. No raw topic replay or parameter changes.
cross_run_readonly_comparison.cross_run_observation: The first bias crossing occurred 3.854677 s after goal dispatch in #214, 4.040592 s in #215, and 1.762286 s in zero-offset #217; zero-offset #216 had no accel-bias crossing and later invalidated on long_tracks_insufficient. All three crossings had normalized_cost below 1.0, while feature/track counts differed. This supports run-to-run variation, not a motion- or filter-specific cause.
cross_run_readonly_comparison.data_limit: No ROS bag/MCAP/DB3 or per-frame VINS preintegration export was present in these four run directories. PX4 ULog files exist, but they are not a direct capture of the VINS IMU input and its preintegration factors; the planned raw-input comparison cannot be completed from these artifacts.
cross_run_readonly_comparison.search_scope: artifacts/runs/*20261020-214 through -217, recursive file suffix inventory
